"Beginning change nahi, but jahan ho start karke end change."
Jo nahi kar sakte, usko mat allow karo—jo kar sakte woh karo.
Wahan mat jaiye jahan raasta le jaaye, balki wahan jaiye jahan koi raasta na ho aur apna nishaan chhodiye.
Log waqai exceptional tab bante hain jab excuses band karke progress start kar dete hain.
"Mind muscle jaisa hai."
Aaj avoid karke kal ki responsibility se bhaag nahi sakte.
Success chahiye, fail hone ko ready hona.
"Disappointment process ka hissa hai."
Utna risk zyada, jitna safe lagta.
